sources.title: G4.5 C1 Cross-Platform Interaction Ingress Architecture v0.1

trusted_statements: C1 unifies cross-platform interaction ingress after C0; it does not redesign interaction semantics.
C0 accepted result boundary is d861e05e18a0665c0c91c7523925b3990bb0c88e.
Platform code owns OS event extraction and native capture/lifecycle realization only.
runtime/input owns common normalized input, pointer generation/lifecycle, provenance, capabilities, and the pass-through InputCaptureGate.
runtime/input must not depend on Arc.
Arc ABI is not the canonical Canvas platform-input contract.
Any Axiom-to-Arc input conversion belongs in common composition/integration code, not platform OS files and not runtime/input.
Web, Android, and Windows must stop owning common pointer generation and interaction/Brush routing policy.
Apple gets a shared extracted-event adapter contract and fixture parity; C1 does not invent a full AppKit/UIKit Product Shell.
Current C0/G4.4 AutoIntent, viewport, slop, predicted-sample, and accepted P34-NB-01 behavior must remain unchanged.
C1 successor is D0 Dear ImGui Common UI Foundation.
